shared_elements: procession of standing human figures in profile
figures in long robes with patterned/curled hair and beards
figures carrying objects or leading animals
horizontal relief frieze along a wall base/stair face
repeated figures facing the same direction in a single register
hands of one figure touching/holding the figure or animal ahead
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive scheme: a single-register frieze of bearded, long-robed male figures in strict profile, all moving in one direction, closely spaced, some carrying vessels or gifts and some leading animals, with hands touching the figure ahead. B additionally includes rams led by attendants and a rosette border band, and A's frieze is more eroded and lacks visible animals, but the processional convention, figure proportions, hair/beard treatment and drapery rendering appear identical.
